title: Input
description: A text input field with label, prefix/suffix, icons, clearable, character count, loading state, and validation support.

label.description: React.ReactNode - Label rendered above the input.

description.description: React.ReactNode - Helper text rendered below the label.

error.description: Displays the input in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the input.

success.description: Green success state for validated fields.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the input.

size.description: Visual size variant. Emits data-size on the root container for CSS targeting.

prefix.description: React.ReactNode - Inline text or element rendered before the input (e.g. '$', 'https://').

suffix.description: React.ReactNode - Inline text or element rendered after the input (e.g. 'USD', '.com').

startIcon.description: React.ReactNode - Icon rendered before the input. Becomes a button when onStartIconClick is provided.

endIcon.description: React.ReactNode - Icon rendered after the input. Becomes a button when onEndIconClick is provided.

onStartIconClick.description: () => void - Makes startIcon a clickable button. Requires startIconLabel for accessibility.

onEndIconClick.description: () => void - Makes endIcon a clickable button. Requires endIconLabel for accessibility.

startIconLabel.description: Accessible label for startIcon when it is clickable. Required with onStartIconClick.

endIconLabel.description: Accessible label for endIcon when it is clickable. Required with onEndIconClick.

onValueChange.description: (value: string) => void - Fires with the current string value when the value changes.

clearable.description: Show a built-in clear button when the input has a value.

onClear.description: () => void - Callback when the clear button is clicked.

showCount.description: Show character count (requires maxLength to be set).

loading.description: Shows a loading spinner inside the input.

loader.description: React.ReactNode - Custom loader element to replace the default spinner.

loaderSize.description: Size of the default CircularLoader in pixels. Ignored when a custom loader prop is provided.

fullWidth.description: Makes the input span the full width of its container.

className.description: CSS class for the root container element.

classes.description: Slot-based class overrides for internal elements.

unstyled.description: When true, all default classes are removed so you can style from scratch.

required.description: Marks the field required and draws the required indicator.

htmlFor.description: The id of the control this labels. Set automatically when the label is rendered by the field.

className.description: Additional classes for the root element.
